summary:
We are Team R.E.T.E.C, For this hackathon, we made 'The Silent Pioneers of Space Exploration,' a 9-slide digital narrative storytelling presentation addressing 'Abandoned but not Forgotten' challenge.

Our project honors historical NASA hardware left behind across the Moon and Mars, including Apollo Lunar Module Descent Stages, the Opportunity Rover, and the InSight Lander. 

Rather than viewing these as 'space junk', our presentation views them as valuable time capsules that preserved critical science and paved the way for modern exploration.

This project will educate students and young space enthusiasts about humanity's cosmic heritage and inspire the next generation of space engineers.
details:
'The Silent Pioneers of Space Exploration' is a visual narrative storytelling presentation designed to educate young space enthusiasts about NASA's discarded hardware on the Moon and Mars. It explains why spacecraft are left behind after their missions and highlights three iconic hardwares: the Apollo Lunar Module Descent Stages, the Opportunity Rover, and the InSight Lander.

Instead of viewing inactive spacecraft as 'space junk', our project honors them as historical artifacts that paved the way for modern science. By turning complicated data into a simple story, it makes planetary science engaging for students and inspires the next generation of space engineers.

We used a simple narrative storytelling style, framing the machines as "silent pioneers", paired with clean text and strong visual contrast so younger readers can learn without feeling overwhelmed.

Tools Used:

  • Canva: Slide design and layout.
  • NASA Open Data & Archives: Solar System Exploration, Mars Exploration Program, and NSSDCA.
  • Google Gemini (SI Tool): Research synthesis and text refinement.
